pretreatment: cleaned in 48% HF/ethanol to remove the native oxide, rinsed with ethanol and blown free of particles, hydroxylated with a 0.2 Torr, 2 min H20 plasma
surface_functionalization: hydroxylated with a 0.2 Torr, 2 min H20 plasma
evidence: The silicon substrates were first cleaned in 48% HF/ethanol to remove the native oxide. The samples were then rinsed with ethanol and blown free of particles before mounting. Subsequently, the silicon samples were mounted on a 2.0 inch diameter heater on the sample transfer puck. An additional silicon sample with a K-type thermocouple was mounted identically to monitor the sample temperature. After sample introduction in the deposition chamber, the surface of the Si(100) samples was cleaned and hydroxylated with a 0.2 Torr, 2 min H20 plasma.
